questions.q: What does Genesis 7:2-3 show about clean and unclean beasts?
choices: The Most High defined them back in Genesis, before Moses
They were first named by Moses
There was no difference before the flood
questions.explain: The dietary law was not yet instituted, but clean and unclean were already defined; Moses reiterated that law (Leviticus 11:45-47).

questions.q: How was the ground watered before the flood?
choices: A mist went up from the earth
questions.explain: Up until this point it had never rained on the earth (Genesis 2:5-6).

questions.q: What are the windows of heaven opened in Genesis 7:11?
choices: The sky, and their opening is the rain
questions.explain: The great deep is the seas, rivers and oceans; the windows of heaven are the sky, and their opening is the rain.

questions.q: According to 2 Esdras 3, why did the flood come?
choices: Because the earth was too full
Because the giants fought the angels
questions.explain: Destruction came because of sin; only Noah and his household were left, of whom came all righteous men.
